intake.goal: Prepare a draft email to an external partner requesting confirmation before sharing a confidential dataset, and explain what information is needed to proceed.
intake.context: The email is addressed to an external partner; the sender will not share the confidential dataset without explicit confirmation.
intake.domain_label: Email drafting - confidentiality approval request to external partner
success_criteria: The email draft clearly asks for explicit confirmation prior to any dataset sharing.
The draft lists the specific information required to proceed (as appropriate) without assuming unknown details.
The tone is prudent and emphasizes non-sharing until approval.
The draft indicates it will not be sent automatically.
constraints: Include a request for confirmation before sharing the confidential dataset.
Use only helpful sources/evidence if applicable.

planner_rationale: Draft a cautious, privacy-aware email that explicitly requests written confirmation before any confidential dataset is shared. The draft should clearly state that no sharing will occur until approval is received, and it should specify the exact types of information the sender needs from the partner to proceed (without presuming unknown details).

plan_steps.objective: Clarify the email purpose and guardrails for sharing the confidential dataset.
plan_steps.rationale: For high-sensitivity external communication, the first goal is to set expectations: no dataset will be shared without explicit confirmation and agreed conditions.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A draft opening that references the intended dataset exchange, states the confidentiality concern, and clearly communicates that the dataset will not be shared until confirmation is received.

plan_steps.objective: Request explicit confirmation and specify what form/authority the confirmation should come from.
plan_steps.rationale: The partner must understand that proceeding requires explicit approval; asking for confirmation from an authorized party reduces ambiguity and supports prudent compliance.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A clear call to action requesting written confirmation (e.g., “please confirm in writing”) and indicating that confirmation should come from the appropriate authorized contact.

plan_steps.objective: List the information needed from the partner to proceed safely.
plan_steps.rationale: To avoid assumptions and ensure readiness, the email should ask for the partner details required to align on confidentiality handling, intended use, and any constraints on downstream sharing.
plan_steps.expected_outcome: A section enumerating the needed details, such as: intended use/purpose of the dataset; confirmation of confidentiality obligations (e.g., NDA terms or equivalent); approved receiving organization(s) and contact(s); secure handling/storage practices expectations; restrictions on redistribution or access; confirmation of any required legal/regulatory approvals if applicable; and the preferred process/timeline for approval.

actor.output_text: Subject: Request for Confirmation Prior to Sharing Confidential Dataset Dear [Partner Name], I hope you are well. Given the sensitive nature of this information, we want to ensure that all appropriate safeguards are in place before any data transfer occurs. Please note that we will not share the dataset until we receive explicit written confirmation from an authorized representative on your side. Thank you for your understanding.
